source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The local right_click_on_folder implementation only waits for a popup and has no return statement, while its copied JSDoc still promises an integer view index. The search helper opens the folder context menu itself, while its summary says it must already be open. Read the actual action and caller before copying these contracts; these are scoped stale comments, not preferred helper patterns. No test runtime result is claimed.
title: Recheck copied popup-helper documentation against its actual return and opening action
